title: OneNote: Copilot Notebooks suggest artifacts to create
summary: Hold: Cloud Policy is not the only documented governance lever for Copilot Notebooks; Microsoft also documents app-level Conditional Access and Purview controls. The rollout, default state and licensing attribution are supported, but the control notes need small clarifications.

claims.claim: Copilot Notebooks are stored in a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The container appears as Loop in SharePoint admin center, PowerShell and Purview audit data.
claims.quote: Across the SharePoint admin center, PowerShell, and Purview audit data, this container's application name is always Loop — even when it only stores Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: Audit and storage queries for this feature are not separable from Loop.
claims.quote: There's no separate Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks application filter.
claims.fix: Replace 'so audit and storage queries for this feature are not separable from Loop' with 'so there is no separate Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks application filter'. This preserves the documented limitation without implying that other audit filters are unavailable.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy for Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation is the only documented governance lever.
claims.quote: Conditional Access: Only applies at the app level. ... applies to the entire app at m365.cloud.microsoft. ... Retention policies ... are enforced for all Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.fix: Replace 'The only documented lever is the Cloud Policy setting' with 'The documented Cloud Policy setting'. Keep the remainder of the sentence; do not imply that Microsoft documents no other governance controls.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy setting governs Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration as a whole.
claims.quote: Disabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration aren't available to the users.

claims.claim: Disabling creation prevents users creating new Copilot Pages or Notebooks.
claims.quote: When creation is disabled, users are unable to create new Copilot Pages or Notebooks.

claims.claim: Disabling creation hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.claim: Disabling creation does not delete existing Pages and Notebooks.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted.

claims.claim: Users with permission can still view and edit existing items after creation is disabled.
claims.quote: Users can still view and edit existing items if they have permission.

claims.claim: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks do not work when creation is disabled by the policy.
claims.quote: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks don't work when creation is disabled via the policy in this article.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center path ends at Configure Settings after Customization, Policy Management and the creation wizard.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. ... On the Policy configurations page, select Create. ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path to 'Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks'. Cite the existing admin policies source for the final setting.

claims.fix: Keep the call. Add to controls[0].note: 'Set mode to applyOnce and set baseline.resources[].properties.value for microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks to "0" to disable or "1" to enable.' The value property is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources#copilotpagesnotebooks-resource-type.

claims.claim: Purview audit and retention routines can be used for Copilot Notebooks content.

claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to review audit and retention routines without corresponding control rows.

claims.fix: Remove the After rollout bullet beginning 'Review the files users generate from notebooks with your usual Purview audit and retention routines'; the checklist names audit and retention controls that have no table rows.

claims.claim: The action rating is prepare despite a launched, on-by-default change rated medium risk.
claims.quote: status: "launched"; defaultState: "on"; risk: "medium"; action: "prepare"; Plan for the support and training load now
claims.fix: Set action to 'act-now': the change is launched, reaches eligible users without admin action, has medium risk, and the page identifies a control decision and communications to complete now.
